title: architecture.md per module: conclusive decisions and why, for the 12 most-used modules

chat.text: A template goes into the documentation skill: what the module is and its pattern, then one entry per decision (the decision, why, the alternative and trade-off, a link to where it was decided), no dates, no reversal history. A census script ranks modules by how many files import them; Sonnet minions write the top 12, reviewed against the code. Readmes link it; decisions.md stays as history.
